Engagement Email

On Sunday 16th July @ 2am Dougal something special happened in Melbourne at the Langham Hotel...

I proposed to Vicky aka Lady V and with no hesitation she replied yes!

So there we have it, she's now an offical lady and engaged to be my wife...

Fair dinkum.

Look forward to seeing you all in November for our flying visit.

Cheers,
Dougs
